what: The eight remaining presenter spans, submitted as one batch, on the route the accepted 03-open take proved.
route: seedance_2_5 omni_reference, 720p 9:16 24fps, P1 as image_references, K01 + K08 as video_references, the unpadded span slice as audio_references; then fal-ai/sync-lipsync/react-1 {model_mode: lips, emotion: neutral, lipsync_mode: cut_off, temperature: 0.5} with the same slice.

cost.method: Read the per-call charge from the transaction ledger afterwards, not from the balance. The balance is also spent from outside this session.

no_retry: A take that fails is reported, not resubmitted. Each resubmission is new paid work and needs its own authorization.
duration_note: generate_s is ceil(speech)+1. If the provider does not accept 13s it clamps to 12, which still exceeds both 13s takes' speech (11.625 and 11.291), so clamping is safe.
prompt_template:
One continuous {dw}-second vertical 9:16 handheld front-camera selfie video of the man in the IMAGE reference, filmed on a phone held close, just above eye level and angled slightly down; his face fills most of the frame and only his shoulders and the top of his chest show, with no arm or hand in frame. Preserve his identity, clear-framed glasses, neatly trimmed beard and short hair, light blue chambray button-down, the small country inn breakfast room with the wooden table edge running across the lower frame and the window to the right, lighting and framing exactly as in the IMAGE.

The first VIDEO supplies connected public-facing articulation to the lens. The second VIDEO supplies relaxed listening stillness and ordinary blinks. They are behavior references only. Do not copy their clothing, room, lighting, unrelated speech or mouth timing. Keep relaxed conversational facial settling, ordinary blinks and comfortable stillness in the face. Below the neck the body is alive and conversational: breathing visible in the shoulders and small shoulder shifts with emphasis. The frame has the gentle natural sway of a hand-held phone. The IMAGE controls identity and setting. The AUDIO controls words, voice, cadence and pauses.

He speaks only the exact {speech}-second AUDIO reference, candid and relaxed, like telling a colleague how the work actually goes: "{text}"

Lip sync is the priority: mouth shapes match every syllable of the AUDIO precisely and close fully on the pauses. Keep the head steady and facing the lens, with only the small movement that speech stress causes; no sway, tilt, turn or repeated nod. After the last word the face holds its relaxed rest, eyes on the lens, with no extra words until the picture ends.

No finger point, head shake, wink, smirk, raised-brow performance or theatrical surprise. Only the slight natural movement of a hand-held phone; no cut, zoom, caption, title, logo, music, additional person or extra objects.

Follow the AUDIO reference at its original speed and cadence. Finish speaking when the AUDIO reference ends. Do not stretch the speech to fill the generated clip.
prompt_derivation: The accepted Wednesday T1 prompt verbatim, with three substitutions: the identity/setting sentence carries EP009's own chambray and inn breakfast room instead of Wednesday's charcoal sweater and home office; the duration and speech-length words; and the spoken line.
spoken_text_verified: Each span's text was read back off its own cut slice with whisper medium.en and matches the text extracted from the owner-locked SPOKEN-TEXT-V1.json by first/last-word anchor. Short 04's close split at 42.083s falls on a sentence boundary: close-a ends at 'a month.', close-b begins at 'Some properties'.
